name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: If either Wrenna does not go with Greataxe or 18 gp goes with Quarterstaff (but not both), then either 28 gp goes with Sable or Sable does not go with Longsword (but not both).
Between 23 gp and 33 gp, one goes with Sable and the other with Warhammer.
Either 28 gp goes with Quarterstaff or 33 gp goes with Warhammer.
Either Warhammer goes with 23 gp or Wrenna goes with 23 gp.
Between Greataxe and Quarterstaff, one goes with Fenwick and the other with 18 gp.
